ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being described as the 'Perspicuous Book' in Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's role as the definitive, unambiguous criterion (Furqan) that guides the faithful through the trials of the Day of Judgment. It highlights the divine attribute of clarity, ensuring that the message of Tawhid remains accessible and distinct from confusion, a theme central to the Imams' teachings on interpreting revelation.
